proposals.what: A 62 s TikTok explainer of "ICM": numbered stage folders, a per-stage contract (inputs → process → exactly one durable output file), a human review gate between stages, and "state in files, not chat" so the next stage loads what a session cannot remember. In SignalGrid it maps onto surfaces that already do this by gate (sim-requests→sim-results bound by `scripts/check-sim-requests.mjs`, lane mail with addressee-only acks, LOOP.md STATE read by the SessionStart/Stop hooks, the SDD brief→report→ledger files) and onto three places where a stage boundary still crosses through chat: the brain-cycle dispatch stage (a board format is designed, none has ever been written), the 2026-09-19 intake rule (self-scan → roster confirm → brain decides) whose per-stage outputs live only in row prose, and Workflow/dispatch runs whose worker output is a chat return.
proposals.alreadyHere: Most of ICM is already gated here, not merely practised. (1) Stage contract with a binding check: artifacts/sim-requests/<id>.json → artifacts/sim-results/<id>.json, enforced by scripts/check-sim-requests.mjs (preflight.mjs:440-441): a result must bind to a request, may report only what was asked, and an unrun request is reported pending, never green. (2) Cross-lane handoff by file with an addressee-only, note-bearing ack: artifacts/lane-messages/*.json + acks/, scripts/lane-message.mjs:160-170, 136 messages on disk. (3) Session state in a file the harness loads: docs/agent/LOOP.md:47 STATE block printed by .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:121-131 and checked against reality by scripts/loop-state.mjs at Stop (verify-done.sh:27); docs/agent/CONTINUITY.md is the scribe's between-session buffer. (4) The brain cycle's decide stage: scripts/brain-cycle.mjs reads one <lens>.<lane>.json per lens plus _manifest.json (expected lenses) and writes exactly one decision.json; a missing/empty/unparsable manifest throws, a malformed lens reads as ran:false (brain-cycle.mjs:50-78); self-tested in preflight.mjs:201-203 and review-hub-ci.yml:697-701; the human gate is auto-OPEN draft only (brain-cycle-config.json autoMergeGreenSwitch:false). (5) Worker handoff by file: subagent-driven-development brief → report → progress.md ledger (SKILL.md:141-150, 258-266) with scripts/sdd-workspace, task-brief, review-package. (6) The video-intake skill's own Steps 1-4 (SKILL.md:41-84) and tool-evaluation-by-use §1 'Log the row first' (SKILL.md:12-18) are staged handoffs whose one durable output is the intake row landed by PR. Absence claims checked: `check:absence "stage contract"` CORROBORATED, `check:absence "self-scan"` CORROBORATED on mainline (present only on unmerged 7a28e26a, rows 103-104), `check:absence "review gate"` INCONCLUSIVE — the one match (docs/company/ROLE_CATALOG.md:761) is a catalogue sentence, read.
